wizard.title: New run
wizard.description: Start the pipeline in {project}. You approve each stage before the next one starts.
wizard.notAllowed: You are a viewer in this project: only owners and researchers can start runs.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: What should the run research? One clear sentence works best.

literature.title: Literature
literature.description: Which papers the literature stage searches for and keeps.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: How far the pipeline goes, and the dataset for the experiment.

budget.title: Models and budget
budget.description: Which LLMs the run may use, and the most it may spend.

review.title: Review
review.description: Check the options and the cost estimate, then start the run.

topic.label: Research topic
topic.placeholder: e.g. Monocular depth estimation on NYU Depth V2
topic.hint: Press Enter to continue, Shift+Enter for a new line.

literature.sourcesHint: The search queries every source you tick.
literature.maxPapersHint: The most relevant papers are screened and analysed: between {min} and {max}.

stages.label: Stop after
stages.hint: Stages always start with the literature and follow the pipeline in order.

descriptions.literature: Only the literature: screened papers, their analyses and a synthesis.
descriptions.method: Adds research proposals built on the literature, to choose from.
descriptions.coding: Adds the model and loss code for the chosen method, for review.
descriptions.experiment: Adds a GPU training run on the dataset, with metrics.
descriptions.writing: The whole pipeline: ends with a paper draft with linked citations.

dataset.label: Dataset
dataset.hint: The experiment trains and evaluates on this dataset (mounted read-only).
dataset.notUsed: This run stops before the experiment, so it does not use a dataset.

budget.freeNotAllowed: This project does not allow free models.
budget.cap: Cost cap for this run (USD, optional)
budget.capHint: Paid calls stop at this amount; the run continues on free models.
budget.capHintFree: Free models cost nothing, so a cap only matters if you switch to Auto.

estimate.title: Estimated cost
estimate.unavailable: Fix the highlighted options to see an estimate.
estimate.failed: The cost could not be estimated: {reason}
estimate.stale: These figures are for earlier options: the estimate could not be updated.

paidBlocked.policy: Free models only: this run does not spend money.
paidBlocked.kill_switch: Paid models are switched off for the lab right now, so the run uses free models.
paidBlocked.budget: Your budget for this month is used up, so the run uses free models.
paidBlocked.run_cap: The cost cap is zero, so the run uses free models only.

cappedBy.run_cap: The high end stops at this run's cost cap; past it, the run continues on free models.
cappedBy.budget: The high end stops at what is left of your budget this month.

estimate.budgetRemaining: You have {amount} of paid budget left this month.
estimate.note: An estimate from typical runs, not a quote: you are charged what the run actually uses.
estimate.paidChain: Paid models, in the order they are tried

topic.tooShort: Describe the topic in at least {min} characters.
topic.tooLong: Keep the topic to {max} characters or fewer.

year.invalid: Enter a year as a whole number.
year.order: The first year must not be after the last one.

sources.invalid: One of the sources is not supported.
sources.duplicate: Each source can be chosen only once.

maxPapers.invalid: Enter a whole number of papers.

stages.empty: Choose at least the literature stage.
stages.invalid: One of the stages is not known.
stages.notPrefix: Stages must start with the literature and follow the pipeline order.

dataset.invalid: Choose a dataset from the list.

llmPolicy.invalid: Choose which models the run may use.

budget.invalid: Enter the cap as an amount in US dollars, e.g. 2.50.
budget.tooHigh: The cap can be at most {max} USD.

server.rejected: The server did not accept this value. Check it and try again.
